summary: Join this training course on Building Effective Relationships with Stakeholders. Gain essential skills to foster collaboration and drive successful outcomes.
lede: Communication with stakeholders training helps project and change professionals identify key groups and plan effective engagement. It develops skills in mapping influence, assessing engagement and sentiment, and tailoring communication to different stakeholder needs. Participants also practice building stakeholder registers, communication plans and RACI matrices, then tracking engagement through metrics and executive reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals responsible for navigating complex organizational dynamics, securing cross-functional buy-in, and managing external partnerships.
prerequisites: There are no strict prerequisites for this course. However, participants will benefit most if they have a basic understanding of their organization's current project portfolio or communication challenges. We recommend bringing a sanitized, real-world stakeholder challenge from your workplace to use as a baseline for the practical mapping exercises.
